name: Sticky Business: Seaside Tales
summary:
Dive into a relaxing seaside getaway with Sticky Business: Seaside Tales!

Bring the ocean breeze to your cozy sticker shop with over 113 new stickers and colorful variants inspired by sunny beaches, salty waves, sea creatures, pirate treasures, tropical vacations, and peaceful moments by the shore.

Pack heartfelt orders for brand-new customers and discover 10 charming new stories full of surf contests, beach adventures, drifting romances, pirate conventions, summer vacations, and quiet coastal towns.
This DLC includes:

113 new stickers with additional color variants

10 new customer stories about surfing, pirates, summer vacations, and more!

8 new goodies

6 glitter papers

Whether you love turtles, whales, seashells, surfboards, palm trees, or treasure chests, Seaside Tales brings a splash of ocean magic to your sticker business.
